title: Remote embedding responses are not checked against input count
reasoning: RemoteHttpEmbeddingProvider sends N texts to /embed but only validates that the returned embeddings field is a non-empty list before converting and returning it. It does not require one vector per input, unlike OpenAIEmbeddingProvider, which explicitly treats a count mismatch as a provider error. A remote service bug or incompatible service version can therefore silently drop, add, or reorder vectors, causing callers to associate embeddings with the wrong source text.
recommendation: In RemoteHttpEmbeddingProvider.embed_batch or _validate_response_body, validate len(embeddings) == len(texts) and raise EmbeddingProviderRequestError with a 502 status when it does not match. Keep vector conversion after that check.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included context test file exercises OpenAI LLM responses behavior and does not cover backend/src/embeddings/remote_provider.py or remote embedding response validation.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a pytest for RemoteHttpEmbeddingProvider.embed_batch using a mocked httpx client that returns one embedding for two input texts, asserting EmbeddingProviderRequestError and no partial vector list returned.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/embeddings/remote_provider.py plus a focused remote-provider unit test.
